account.invalidPassword: The password does not meet the requirements.
account.expired: The sign-in expired. Sign in again with your temporary password.
account.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.
account.unreachable: We could not reach the service. Try again in a few minutes.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the username and password that came with your invitation.
choosePassword.title: Choose your password
choosePassword.intro: This is your first sign-in: replace the temporary password with your own.
choosePassword.rules: At least 12 characters, with uppercase, lowercase and numbers.
onboarding.title: Set up your dictation
onboarding.intro: Choose the languages you speak and how the text should read. You can change it later.
style.plain.name: Plain
style.casual.name: Casual
style.formal.name: Formal
style.plain.description: Clean only: drops fillers and punctuates, without changing the tone.
firstRun.title: Welcome to Take My Word
firstRun.tagline: Talk instead of typing, in any app.
firstRun.step1: Put the cursor where the text should go.
firstRun.step3: Release. The text is pasted and your clipboard stays as it was.
firstRun.microphoneNote: Take My Word listens only while you hold the shortcut, and never stores the audio.
firstRun.microphoneBlocked: Windows is blocking the microphone. Turn on access for desktop apps, then try again.
firstRun.microphoneMissing: No microphone found. Connect one and Take My Word will use it.
settings.account.intro: The account you dictate with on this computer.
settings.shortcut.listening: Press the new shortcut, then release it.
settings.autostart.note: Take My Word waits in the tray, ready when you are.
settings.autostart.failed: Windows did not accept the change. Try again.
settings.account.signedOut: Signed out. Sign in to dictate.
hotkey.notInSettings: Click Change in the settings window to record a shortcut.
hotkey.nothingToSave: There is no new shortcut to save.
hotkey.captureEnded: The recording ended. Click Change to try again.
hotkey.keyNotAllowed: That key cannot be part of the shortcut.
hotkey.tooFew: A shortcut needs at least 2 keys held together.
hotkey.tooMany: A shortcut takes at most 3 keys.
hotkey.noModifier: A shortcut needs Ctrl, Shift, Alt or Win.
hotkey.rightAlt: Right Alt is AltGr on many keyboards, so it cannot be part of the shortcut.
overlay.pasteFailed: Couldn't paste the text. Try again.
overlay.microphoneSilent: The microphone sent no sound. Check that it's on.
overlay.microphoneMissing: No microphone found. Plug one in and try again.
overlay.microphoneFailed: The microphone stopped working. Try again.
overlay.unreachable: We could not reach the service. Check your connection.
overlay.tooLong: That dictation was too long. Keep it under two minutes.
notice.clipboardLost: Pasted. Another app held the clipboard, so what you had copied before couldn't be put back.
notice.notPasted: Couldn't paste into that window. The text is on your clipboard.
notice.focusChanged: The window changed while you were dictating, so nothing was pasted. The text is on your clipboard.
notice.elevated: That window runs as administrator, so the text couldn't be pasted. It is on your clipboard.
notice.previousNotPasted: The previous dictation was not pasted.
dictionary.intro: Names, brands and words you want written the same way every time. Aliases are how they sound or get misspelled.
dictionary.empty: Add names, brands or technical words that dictation gets wrong.
dictionary.tooLong: Each term and alias takes at most {max} characters.
dictionary.tooManyAliases: A term takes at most {max} aliases.
dictionary.full: Your dictionary holds at most {max} terms.
dictionary.duplicate: That term is already in your dictionary.
styles.intro: The style decides how each dictation is cleaned up.
styles.defaultNote: Used in every app without a rule.
styles.customEmpty: Describe how you want the text written, then use it as your default or for one app.
styles.name: Name
styles.promptHint: Describe how the text should read, for example: short sentences, no emoji.
styles.nameTooLong: The name takes at most {max} characters.
styles.promptTooLong: The instructions take at most {max} characters.
styles.full: You can keep at most {max} styles of your own.
styles.confirmDelete: Delete? Rules using it go back to the default style.
appRules.intro: Each app can have its own style and paste shortcut.
appRules.appHint: Pick an open app or type its executable, for example notepad.exe.
appRules.empty: Without one, every app uses your default style and Ctrl+V.
appRules.appTooLong: The app name is too long.
appRules.duplicate: That app already has a rule.
appRules.full: You can keep at most {max} rules.
history.intro: Your dictations from the last 90 days. Audio is never stored.
history.empty: They show up here after you dictate and stay for 90 days.
update.title: An update is ready
update.installing: Installing. Take My Word will restart in a few seconds.
update.failed: We couldn't install the update. Try again.
settings.uiLanguage.note: The language of Take My Word's own text.
dictationLanguages.note: The languages you speak. With both, Take My Word recognizes which one each dictation is in.
settings.theme.note: Follows Windows unless you pick one.
styles.customEmptyTitle: No styles of your own yet
